kit.title: Embroidered patch
kit.summary: A machine-embroidered Courier patch, 88 mm (3.46 in) across, in 5 thread colors and 10,571 stitches. For a 4 x 4 in hoop. Written for DST (most machines), EXP (Melco, Bernina) and PES (Brother, Baby Lock); not yet sewn on a real machine.

previews.alt: Stitch simulation of the Maximus patch: a ten-point amber star on midnight navy with COURIER and MAXIMUS round the rim
